digest.component_or_area: pytest snapshot fixture teardown / conftest cleanup
propositions: Path.rglob() on Python 3.11 caches directory entries and raises FileNotFoundError when a cached child directory vanishes before descent, unlike Python 3.12 which tolerates the same concurrent removal.

The autouse snapshot teardown fixture recursively descended into an unrelated mutable tracker lock directory that was concurrently removed by canonical store lock lifecycle, causing fixture failure on Python 3.11.
Test-scoped os.name monkeypatch to 'nt' caused pathlib.Path() factory calls in cleanup code to raise NotImplementedError on Python 3.11 when constructing WindowsPath on POSIX systems.

Repair using os.walk() with onerror handler to ignore only FileNotFoundError for concurrently vanished entries while preserving other scan errors and maintaining recursive exact-root .rebar/run_snapshots discovery.
The _rmtree_writable helper in snapshot.py also required Path factory stabilization against the same ambient os.name monkeypatch to prevent teardown failures on Python 3.11.
